lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Anchor nine. Ninety-two megawatts, and the arc node's cleared for field use as of this morning.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: It cycles fast. It will not get through plate — you want fewer, harder hits for that, not more of them.
lines.beat: prices the armour lesson before the player pays for it

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: So the new one is for the small fast ones and the old one is for the big slow ones.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: That's the whole of it, yes.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Control, survey said this one was occupied.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Survey said it was occupied eleven years ago. Proceed.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: There's remains on the gantry. Ordinal. Nobody moved them.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Vasquez. They're at their stations. All of them, still at their stations.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Heavier profile inbound. Plated. Your rate of fire is going to matter less than you'd like.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Over budget. The arc nodes are the expensive ones — that's where the megawatts went.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: We're thin. Take something offline and mean it.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Okonkwo. The bodies on the gantry. Which way were they facing?

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Inward. Every one of them. Their guns are pointed at the ring.
lines.beat: the act's turn, delivered as a survey detail

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: They weren't defending the anchor. They were watching it. I'd like to stop now and I'm going to keep going.
